title: Dustbowl
wikitext:
[[File:Dustbowl.jpg|thumb|300px|The Dustbowl]]

'''The Dustbowl''' is a large area of the northwest of [[Badlands]] between [[Kargath]] and the [[Valley of Fangs]] in the center of the Badlands. It is home to a variety of species including [[coyote]]s, [[Rock Elemental]]s, and [[buzzard]]s. Some flora have been able to grow on the arid landscape such as a myriad of cacti and a few trees. This place also contains [[Camp Wurg]].
